notes.title: We have launched a collaborative bundle with TreeNutsGames!
notes.content:
We have launched a collaborative bundle with TreeNutsGames, the developer of Coin Pusher Casino![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41195882/7f97aaf9a7f06226ae3edba22dd7c96dede0333d.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54252/TreeNutsGames_x_STP_WORKS_Friends_Bundle/

Discover the charm and variety of coin pusher games with this collaborative bundle from STP WORKS and TreeNutsGames!

Experience the full Old Coin Pusher Friends trilogy—STP WORKS beloved Japanese series known for its nostalgic worlds, unique diorama aesthetics, and cozy atmosphere. Then jump into Coin Pusher Casino, a modern, physics-driven twist from TreeNutsGames, offering fast-paced gameplay, flashy visuals, and a mountain of collectible chaos.

Whether you're here for exploration and story or pure arcade action, this bundle brings together two distinct styles, united by one shared love: the thrill of the push.

You have a prize that didn't move a smidge at that fair, don't you? Don't worry, you'll be able to drop those prizes by using shotguns and rapid-fire weapons! notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.1.1)
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem that sometimes prevented Yokai from attacking during online play.

- Fixed an issue where the event music would remain playing for a while if the event ended immediately after joining online play.

- Spelling mistakes corrected.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Additional & Improved Features (Ver. 1.1.0)
notes.content:
- Added a offering box. (You can select it from the screen at the goal.)

- English has been corrected. （Thank you Will Bott for your cooperation)

- Overall load measures have been taken.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the inn signs to be dark when the video quality is set to low.

- Fixed an issue that could cause some settings to be initialized.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Changes and Fixed (Ver 1.0.7)
notes.content:
- The maximum level of "JP Conversion" has been raised to 7.

- The time before auto-aim automatically resumes has been changed to 30 seconds.

- Made the sound of rain a little quieter.

- Fixed a problem in which the same room would be entered even if “Yes” was selected for the “Do you want to try to enter a different room than last time?” option when a quick match was selected.

- Corrected a typographical error.


# Please note that will continue to be matched with players in Version 1.0.6.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver. 1.0.6)
notes.content:
- Countermeasure for the problem of excessive load when a lot of coins are placed on the sugoroku board.

- Fixed an issue where the Ubume feather sometimes did not fall.

- Fixed an issue where the display could be corrupted when moving pieces.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.5)
notes.content:
- Fixed a problem in which the number of treasures delivered at the finish line was displayed as 0.


# Please note that will continue to be matched with players in Version 1.0.4.

notes.title: Improvements and Fixed (Ver. 1.0.4)
notes.content:
● Improvements

- The upper limit of the box expansion level was raised to 8.

- The volume setting range has been adjusted.

- The coins trail setting is now also reflected in "Gatling Coin".

- A sound effect has been added to indicate when "Gatling Coin" is ready for use.

- Added more details to the description of the auto-aim.


● Fixes

- Fixed a problem in which the store in the inn would not open if the menu was left open for a certain period of time while moving to the inn.

- Fixed a problem in which, under certain conditions, when the screen at the finish line is left displayed and the user is forced to leave, the next lap begins without earning a reward.

- Fixed an issue where the icon indicating that the user is away from the seat would sometimes not disappear.

- Corrected a typographical error.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Improvements and Fixed (Ver 1.0.3)
notes.content:
- The message of the coin basket space and the palaquin space has been made easier to understand.

- Fixed an issue where buttons could not be pressed on the goal screen when playing with the gamepad.


# Please note that will continue to be matched with players in Version 1.0.2.

notes.title: Improvements and adjustments (Ver. 1.0.2)
notes.content:
- Added "Translucent other players" item to settings.

- The number of coins replenished at the end of the event has been increased.

- Reduced by one the number of dice replenished at the end of the event for multiplayer only.

- Fixed an issue where coins would not fly away when the wind blew if a monitor with a high refresh rate (120hz or higher) was used.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Improvements and adjustments (Ver. 1.0.1)
notes.content:
- Added markers for spaces to stop.

- Added a button for "Avatar Shop" at the goal screen.

- The rate of dice appearing in multiplayer games has been adjusted.

- The sound of the wind has been reduced a little.
